reasons: The menu stays open when the user clicks elsewhere.

terms.meaning: a count of days in a row a habit was completed
the habit's current state, such as active, paused or archived
a library that makes small movements, such as the bounce on the Log button, smooth

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Loads the animation library, icons, the habit type, the store, the card and badge parts, the edit popup and the helper that gives today's date.
sections.why: Gathers what the card needs to draw and act.

sections.name: HabitCardProps
sections.title: Habit input
sections.what: Declares that the card receives one habit.
sections.why: Keeps each card tied to one habit record.

sections.name: HabitCard (part 1)
sections.title: Today's status and header
sections.what: Reads the store actions, sets up edit and menu switches, works out whether today is done or skipped, maps each category to an icon, and draws the header with title, status badges, category and difficulty.
sections.why: Sets the card's daily state from the habit's record.
sections.watch_out: Today's status depends on the date helper, so changing that helper changes what counts as today.

sections.name: HabitCard (part 2)
sections.title: Action menu, first items
sections.what: Draws the menu button and its dropdown, with Edit, Skip Today, Pause or Resume, and Duplicate.
sections.why: Puts management actions in one menu so the card stays clean.
sections.watch_out: The menu closes only when an item is clicked, not when the user clicks elsewhere.

sections.name: HabitCard (part 3)
sections.title: Action menu, last items and footer
sections.what: Draws the Archive or Unarchive item and the Delete item, then the description and the streak footer.
sections.why: Finishes the menu and shows streak information.
sections.watch_out: Delete removes the habit immediately, with no undo.

sections.name: HabitCard (part 4)
sections.title: Daily Log button
sections.what: Shows a Skipped Today label if skipped, otherwise the Log button. The button animates and reads Done Today once completed. Closes the card and renders the edit popup.
sections.why: Gives the one daily action the most prominent place.
sections.watch_out: The Log button is disabled for paused or archived habits, but the Skip item in the menu is not.

summary: One habit as a card with its title, icon, streak, a Log button for today, and a menu for edit, skip, pause, duplicate, archive and delete.
purpose: Lets the user log a habit for today and manage that habit.
why: Keeps the display and actions for one habit together, so the habits list can repeat the card.
how: Reads today's status for the habit. Picks an icon by category. Draws the header with status badges and the action menu. Shows the streak and either the Log button, the Done Today state or the Skipped Today label. Includes the edit popup.
inputs: One habit record and the store actions for logging, skipping, pausing, archiving, duplicating and deleting.
outputs: Changes the habit through the store. Changes the button and label shown.
risks: Delete happens at once with no confirmation. The menu does not close when the user clicks elsewhere. The Log button is disabled for paused or archived habits, but the Skip item in the menu is not disabled for them.
debug: If Log does nothing, check that the habit status is active. If today's state looks wrong, compare the date from getTodayDateString with the stored history keys. If the menu stays open, check isMenuOpen.
